title: Command Palette dock not showing right in vertical display layout

The issue now carries the Needs-Author-Feedback label and has no reporter follow-up after the /needinfo request.
judgment.recommended_action: Preserve the current waiting-on-author state until the reporter answers the per-monitor Dock-content question.

fix_assessment.rationale: The next decision depends on the reporter answering the existing per-monitor Dock question; a new code-level fix proposal would be premature.

A maintainer clarified that each monitor’s Dock is unique and asked whether the reporter had added anything to that specific Dock.
The issue is labeled Needs-Author-Feedback and Product-Command Palette.
inferences: This may be a product-behavior misunderstanding rather than a rendering bug, depending on whether the vertical monitor Dock actually has configured bands.
Without the reporter’s answer, triage cannot tell whether to investigate layout code or simply explain per-monitor Dock configuration.
issue_context.analysis: The bounded revalidation pass should not overwrite an already-specific maintainer request with a new generic ask. The live state is still “waiting on author,” and the next discriminating evidence is the reporter’s answer about per-monitor Dock contents.

The current Command Palette Dock design is per-monitor, so the maintainer’s clarification request is directly relevant to whether this is actually a bug.
